title: Vue render option tag with empty value attribute without attribute

body:
### Vue version

3.4.20

### Link to minimal reproduction

https://play.vuejs.org/#

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create select tag
2. Create `<option value=""></option>`

### What is expected?

```html
<select>
  <option value=""></option>
</select>
```

### What is actually happening?

```html
<select>
  <option></option>
</select>
```
